description: #P exact integer permanent, n≤3, computed by the direct expansion and checked against Ryser's formula. matrix is a decimal-string grid, rows split by | and cells by commas. Returns energy_num = the permanent, energy_den = 1; verdict is WIN when it equals 6 - QMACourtLaw.fixturePermanent, the all-ones 3x3 matrix - and MISS for every other permanent, with detail per=P_want_6; if the two expansions disagree the answer is MISS naming both. n>3 is REFUSED_INSTANCE_BOUND. Floats refused (REFUSED_FLOAT); a field posted as a JSON value that is not a string is REFUSED_NOT_A_STRING. Same law as math_court domain qma_permanent.
name: execute_exact_permanent
